sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "display_name" TEXT NULL, "age_band" TEXT NULL, "primary_goal" TEXT NULL, "obstacle" TEXT NULL, "rhythm" TEXT NULL, "putaway_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "step_size" TEXT NULL, "preferred_activity" TEXT NULL, "anchor_text" TEXT NULL, "activity_material" TEXT NULL, "owns_restnest" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("owns_restnest" IN (0, 1)), "owns_card" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("owns_card" IN (0, 1)), "bedtime_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "phone_away_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC', "notify_programme" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notify_programme" IN (0, 1)), "notify_time_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "cloud_sync_consent_at" TEXT NULL, "intake_step" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "intake_completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "block_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "context" TEXT NULL, "items" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "block_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES block_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_rule" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "default_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "days_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "start_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "auto_start" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_start" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "steps" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ios_selections" ("block_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES block_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "selection_blob" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("block_profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accessories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "token_hash" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "paired_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "routine_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "block_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES block_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "accessory_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accessories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NULL, "blocking_confirmed_at" TEXT NULL, "blocking_released_at" TEXT NULL, "feeling" TEXT NULL, "events" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programme_enrollments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "content_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "started_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "selection" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "direction" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programme_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "enrollment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES programme_enrollments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "size" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', "scheduled_for" TEXT NOT NULL, "offered_at" TEXT NULL, "opened_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "fit" TEXT NULL, "blocker" TEXT NULL, "protected" TEXT NULL, "rested_score" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_notifications" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "programme_day_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES programme_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "routine_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "os_notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "fires_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "fires_at_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entitlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "feature" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "consent_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("target_table"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programme_days_enrollment_day ON programme_days (enrollment_id, day_number)
